gate_semantics.MI: point identified under an explicit, qualified structural/measurement model
gate_semantics.NI: observationally equivalent admissible DGPs produce different target values

proceed_rule.point_estimation: permitted only for O or MI
proceed_rule.formal_inference: permitted only when classification is O or MI and all required assumptions are qualified
proceed_rule.downstream_decision: permitted only when the image of the identified set is decision-invariant

fail_closed_conditions: missing structural identification model for a latent target
observationally equivalent witnesses with different target values
identified-set image crosses a downstream branch boundary
surface computation leaves its declared domain
receipt digest does not match its serialized components

surface_policy.principle: propagate identified sets through every downstream mathematical surface before selecting a branch
surface_policy.stable: all admissible target values map to the same qualitative regime
surface_policy.unstable: admissible target values map to multiple qualitative regimes
surface_policy.boundary: identified set touches a nonregular or singular surface boundary

nonclaims: This schema does not establish any RH-006 latent identification assumption.
A predictive variable is not thereby an instrument.
A numerical grid is not an analytic proof of an identified set.
Partial identification does not authorize point inference.
